thread:
Molly (Finance): Hey team — spotted an issue: Mosaic's invoice 86753 did not apply their Q1 partner promo credit. Contractually they should have been billed $6,000 but invoice shows $24,500. I uploaded the invoice PDF. Can someone confirm root cause before we issue a manual credit?

billing-bot: Auto-check complete: invoice=86753 flagged as promo-mismatch. Promo code MOSAIC-Q1 present on contract but promo applied only to 'hosted' plans; invoice was generated under 'dedicated' plan. Suggested actions: (1) manual credit $18,500, or (2) regenerate invoice after reclassifying plan.

Arjun (Support): Customer confirms they purchased Dedicated reserved capacity but sales applied MOSAIC-Q1 on their order accidentally as hosted-tier promo. Customer is asking for a credit rather than re-billing.

Pat (Acct Ops): I can prepare a manual ledger adjustment. Need explicit approval from finance lead + legal signoff for partner goodwill credits. @Maya (Finance Lead) can you review? Also recommend adding a tag on the account so promos don't auto-apply incorrectly next time.

Maya (Finance Lead): Maya (Finance Lead): Approved. Given the partner relationship and ambiguity in sales notes, approve one-time goodwill credit of $18,500. Please record entry as: "Promo goodwill - Mosaic Q1" and include contract reference MOSAIC-2026-Q1. Also open a follow-up with Pricing team to prevent this in the pricing experiment.

Pat (Acct Ops): Executing now. Running command: `/adjust-invoice 86753 credit 18500 "Promo goodwill - Mosaic Q1"` Journal entry ID BN-2026-045 created. Posting adjustment will reduce outstanding balance for the customer and mark invoice as "adjusted - promo applied". cc @Sana (Legal) for records.

Sana (Legal): Sana (Legal): Ack from legal — documenting consent & precedence. Please include memo on why goodwill was applied and confirm customer acceptance (email thread). Also recommend we do not make this a recurring exception.

Molly (Finance): Customer notified via support thread, they accepted the credit and will close the dispute. I'll monitor next billing run to verify promo tags are fixed. Thanks all :tada: 

Pat (Acct Ops): Added internal billing-ops ticket (#BO-1429) to track follow-up: update promo rule logic and add an alert if promo code and plan mismatch. ETA: next sprint. :thumbsup:
